|lore=Brought to Cloud City by the Empire. Facilitates Imperial-to-alien communication. Relayed carbonite chamber modification instructions to Ugloste. Arrogant. Rude. Vulgar.
|game_text=While with C-3PO, C-3PO’s game text (and game text of cards on him) is canceled. E Chu Ta is destiny +3 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. During any control phase, may take E Chu Ta into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
|printings={{Card versions/E-3PO}}
|notes=The Set 6 sources preserve this publication of E-3PO. The first surviving slip names Threepio at the same location. The remaster refers to being with C-3PO. Each cancels his and attached cards’ game text and retains the E Chu Ta bonus and control-phase search. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=42 period rules] distinguish “with” from “present with.”
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards6.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #32 on 14 September 2007); page 3, slip 33. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
